info.name: INT HR Platform API - Complete Server Functions Collection (100% Coverage)
info.description: Complete and exhaustive Postman collection for the INT HR Management System covering all 396 TanStack Start server functions across 65 backend modules plus Supabase Auth endpoints. Includes full request schemas, input payloads, environment variables, authentication tokens, and headers for Employees, Geofencing, Biometrics, Attendance, Leaves, Advances/Solaf, Permissions, Contracts, Custody, KPIs, Tasks, Trips, Payroll, and Security.
